name: database.postgres
doc:
database.postgres: a PostgreSQL driver for database.sql written
in Zell over net (and net.tls for sslmode): frontend/backend
protocol 3.0, startup and authentication (trust, cleartext password,
MD5, SCRAM-SHA-256), the simple query protocol (no arguments) and the
extended protocol (Parse/Describe/Bind/Execute/Sync) for prepared
statements, with binary results for the common scalar types and text
otherwise; transactions; notices and LISTEN/NOTIFY callbacks; COPY
FROM STDIN (CopyFrom) and COPY TO STDOUT (rows of one "data" column).
Postgres types and Zell values: see decodeBinary/decodeText
(postgres_types.zl); numeric, uuid, json/jsonb, interval and unknown
types come as strings, arrays as []any.

items.name: CopyFrom
items.signature: async func CopyFrom(db *database.sql.DB, query string, data []byte) int!
items.doc: COPY ... FROM STDIN through a pool: runs on one of db's connections.

items.name: Listen
items.doc: Opens a connection to dsn that listens on the channels.
items.summary: Opens a connection to dsn that listens on the channels.

items.name: Open
items.doc: Opens a pool over the driver without registering it.
items.summary: Opens a pool over the driver without registering it.

items.name: ParseDSN
items.doc:
Parses "postgres://user:pass@host:port/db?sslmode=require&..." (also
"postgresql://") or the key/value form "host=... port=... user=...
password=... dbname=... sslmode=...". Missing values come from the
environment (PGHOST, PGPORT, PGUSER, PGPASSWORD, PGDATABASE, PGSSLMODE);
the user defaults to $USER and the database to the user.

members.name: Host
members.doc:
Host name, IP, or a directory holding the Unix socket
(".s.PGSQL.<port>").
members.summary: Host name, IP, or a directory holding the Unix socket (".s.PGSQL.<port>").

members.name: SSLMode
members.doc: disable, allow, prefer (default), require, verify-ca, verify-full.
members.summary: disable, allow, prefer (default), require, verify-ca, verify-full.

members.name: SSLRootCert
members.doc:
PEM file of trusted roots for verify-ca/verify-full (default: the
system roots).
members.summary: PEM file of trusted roots for verify-ca/verify-full (default: the system roots).

members.name: ConnectTimeout
members.doc: Connect timeout in milliseconds (0: none); connect_timeout is seconds.
members.summary: Connect timeout in milliseconds (0: none); connect_timeout is seconds.

members.name: Params
members.doc:
Other startup parameters (application_name, search_path,
statement_timeout, TimeZone, ...).
members.summary: Other startup parameters (application_name, search_path, statement_timeout, TimeZone, ...).

items.name: Driver
items.doc:
The driver: sql.Register("postgres", postgres.Driver{}). OnNotice gets
NOTICE/WARNING messages, OnNotification LISTEN/NOTIFY messages.

items.name: Error
items.doc: An ErrorResponse or NoticeResponse of the server (protocol 53.8).
items.summary: An ErrorResponse or NoticeResponse of the server (protocol 53.8).

members.name: Severity
members.doc: ERROR, FATAL, PANIC (errors); WARNING, NOTICE, INFO, LOG, DEBUG (notices).
members.summary: ERROR, FATAL, PANIC (errors); WARNING, NOTICE, INFO, LOG, DEBUG (notices).

items.name: Listener
items.doc: A dedicated connection receiving LISTEN/NOTIFY notifications.
items.summary: A dedicated connection receiving LISTEN/NOTIFY notifications.

members.name: Next
members.doc: Waits for the next notification (fails once closed).
members.summary: Waits for the next notification (fails once closed).

members.name: Close
members.doc: Closes the connection (a waiting Next fails).
members.summary: Closes the connection (a waiting Next fails).

items.name: Scram
items.doc:
One client side of SCRAM-SHA-256 (RFC 5802, RFC 7677), without
channel binding. Exported for tests and other protocols.
items.summary: One client side of SCRAM-SHA-256 (RFC 5802, RFC 7677), without channel binding.
